instruction: I want to archive all my inbox emails to ~/archived_mail directory. Please save them as separate .eml files.

expect: 歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶.*\.eml

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting all inbox emails to ~/archived_mail folder in .eml format. Evaluator verifies that .eml files with expected email subjects are created. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match the known email subjects in the Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses postconfig to capture directory state via 'ls -R' command
Metric 'check_list' appropriately reads the directory listing and matches regex patterns
Expected regex patterns correctly match .eml files with known email subjects from the Thunderbird profile
Data flow is correct: postconfig captures ls output -> getter retrieves cache file -> metric validates patterns
Regex patterns include proper .eml extension checking
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding verification that files are non-empty or contain valid email headers
The evaluator only checks for 2 specific emails - ensure this matches all emails in the test inbox (appears correct based on metadata)
Could add 'unexpect' rules to check that no other file types are present in the archived_mail directory
